exact_math: For country i with original p_i, shadow q_i, known state s_i, define Delta_i(Y)=(q_i-Y)^2-(p_i-Y)^2. With binary transition T_i=1[Y_i != s_i], Delta_i=base_i+T_i*w_i, base_i=(q_i-s_i)^2-(p_i-s_i)^2<0, w_i=2*abs(q_i-p_i)>0. For K changes among n fixed countries, sharp min/max of SUM Delta_i / n use K smallest/largest w_i, respectively.
limitations: SHARP conditional on an arbitrary K-subset: no geopolitical feasibility constraint, independence assumption, estimated correlation or probability assigned to K or to any switching combination. All 2027 labels remain unknown. Probability-weighted score expectation under the original and under the shadow are mutually exclusive hypothetical data-generating assumptions. The secondary shadow was chosen post hoc after looking at historical 2024/25 labels, even though its 2027 outcomes are future.
target_definition: Change in state-based UCDP OrganizedViolenceCY 25+ deaths threshold from 2025 status to 2027 status; not war onset or negotiated peace
